mapper.select: select cxr.TIRE_RING_CODE beadCode, /*胎圈代码*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS1_PLAN_QTY),0) CX_CLASS1_PLAN_CONSUME, /*半制品对应成型(7点-7点)计划量的消耗量 一个胎对应1副胎圈*/ IFNULL(sum(cxr.CLASS2_PLAN_QTY),0) CX_CLASS2_PLAN_CONSUME /*半制品对应成型(7点-19点)计划量的消耗量 一个胎对应1副胎圈*/ from ( select r.EMBRYO_CODE, r.BOM_DATA_VERSION, max(ci.TIRE_RING_CODE) TIRE_RING_CODE, /*胎圈代码*/ sum(IFNULL(CLASS3_PLANNED_QTY, 0)) CLASS1_PLAN_QTY, /*7点-隔天7点成型计划量*/ sum(IFNULL(CLASS2_PLAN_QTY, 0)) CLASS2_PLAN_QTY /*7点-19点成型计划量*/ from T_CX_SCHEDULE_RESULT r inner join T_MDM_CONSTRUCTION_INFO ci on r.EMBRYO_CODE = ci.CONSTRUCTION_CODE and r.BOM_DATA_VERSION = ci.CONSTRUCTION_VERSION and ci.IS_DELETE = 0 /*施工信息表*/ where schedule_date = STR_TO_DATE(#{scheduleDate}, '%Y-%m-%d') and r.IS_DELETE = 0 group by r.EMBRYO_CODE,r.BOM_DATA_VERSION ) cxr /*成型排程结果表*/ group by cxr.TIRE_RING_CODE
SELECT BEAD_CODE, IFNULL(SUM(CLASS1_PLAN_QTY), 0) consume FROM T_TQ_SCHEDULE_RESULT WHERE SCHEDULE_DATE = DATE_ADD(#{scheduleDate}, INTERVAL -1 day) AND IS_DELETE = 0 GROUP BY BEAD_CODE
